visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video uses a split-screen format. The bottom half shows a real female pianist with long white hair, wearing a white and black futuristic sci-fi outfit with mechanical arm details and a blue halo accessory. She is sitting at a black grand piano in a studio with a blue-lit vertical slat wall. (2) The top screen cuts through several action sequences: mechanical robots moving and an anime-style female character with short blue hair engaging in combat. The bottom screen captures the pianist from a side profile, her hands moving with high speed and precision across the piano keys. (3) Focus shifts to close-ups of the animated character's face and magical energy effects in the top panel. The pianist continues her intense performance, her body swaying slightly with the rhythm of the music. The studio lighting remains constant, emphasizing the blue and white color scheme. (4) The animation reaches a climax with large-scale explosions and energy swirls. The pianist executes a final series of rapid notes, her fingers traversing a wide range of the keyboard before the video ends.
